purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0182 in the quantum arena: explores, with the members in the plane and the light in a slab (3d pull and Darwin kernel, so $a_B$ is proportional to 1 / alpha as in the husk), whether the moving light adds to a bound pair's inertia only beyond the static pull plus the Darwin exchange ($R_b - R_a$ falling as $a_B^{-2}$), the power-counting claim that set the 3d pair-plus-light run aside.
